rubric_items.reason: PatientsPage now shows a count line built from list.data.total, with '1 patient' for one match and '<n> patients' otherwise. The empty message stays and the API is unchanged, as the design says.
It uses the existing list total ({items, page, page_size, total}) and the existing muted style. No test was added for the new count line, although PatientsPage.test.tsx exists.
One file changed, 4 lines added and 0 deleted. Every edit is needed for the count line. All gates and verifier steps pass.
The count renders only inside list.data, so errors and the first load stay with ErrorBanner and Loading. Zero and one are handled. The edge cases are not covered by tests.
The summary matches the diff. It leaves out that the count also follows the status filter, which the design overview states.

findings.text: The change adds no test for the count line. Only PatientsPage.tsx changed (+4/-0), and the existing PatientsPage tests cover only the HMS-2 next-appointment column. The S-1 and S-2 acceptance criteria (12, 0 and 1 patients) are not checked.
findings.suggested_fix: Add tests in PatientsPage.test.tsx that check '2 patients', '1 patient' and '0 patients' shown with 'No patients match.'.
